# Create project directory
mkdir -p /home/user/godot_project/scenes
mkdir -p /home/user/godot_project/scripts

# Create project.godot
cat <<EOF > /home/user/godot_project/project.godot
config_version=5
[application]
config/name="TweenSequence"
run/main_scene="res://scenes/Animator.tscn"
EOF

# Create TweenController.gd
cat <<EOF > /home/user/godot_project/scripts/TweenController.gd
extends Node

signal step_a_complete
signal step_b_complete
signal step_c_complete
signal animation_complete

@onready var target = get_parent().get_node("Target")
var _running = false

func is_running() -> bool:
    return _running

func play_sequence() -> Tween:
    _running = true
    var tween = create_tween()
    
    # Step 1 (0-1s)
    tween.tween_property(target, "position", Vector2(200, 100), 1.0).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_LINEAR)
    tween.tween_callback(func(): emit_signal("step_a_complete"))
    
    # Step 2 (1-2s) - Parallel
    var parallel_group = tween.parallel()
    parallel_group.tween_property(target, "scale", Vector2(2, 2), 1.0).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_LINEAR)
    parallel_group.tween_property(target, "modulate:a", 0.5, 1.0).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_LINEAR)
    tween.tween_callback(func(): emit_signal("step_b_complete"))
    
    # Step 3 (2-3s)
    tween.tween_property(target, "rotation", PI/2, 1.0).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
    tween.tween_callback(func(): emit_signal("step_c_complete"))
    
    # Step 4 (3-3.5s)
    tween.tween_property(target, "modulate:r", 0.5, 0.5).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)
    tween.tween_callback(func(): 
        _running = false
        emit_signal("animation_complete")
    )
    
    return tween
EOF

# Create Animator.tscn
# Need to use a format Godot understands. Since creating it via text is tricky, 
# I will use a simple text representation and hope for the best, 
# or use a minimal tscn format.
cat <<EOF > /home/user/godot_project/scenes/Animator.tscn
[gd_scene load_steps=2 format=3 uid="uid://c6u7k5j8k7"]

[ext_resource type="Script" path="res://scripts/TweenController.gd" id="1_controller"]

[node name="Animator" type="Node2D"]

[node name="Target" type="Node2D" parent="."]

[node name="TweenController" type="Node" parent="."]
script = ExtResource("1_controller")
EOF

# No changes needed, but I'll verify the file contents quickly.
cat /home/user/godot_project/scripts/TweenController.gd
